name: Kyonyuu JK Saiin Choukyou -Kimoani wa Imouto o Milk Nomi Ningyou ni-
original_name: 巨乳JK催淫調教-キモ兄は妹をミルク飲み人形に-
source:
The protagonist, Hikida Tooru, is a shut-in living in his family’s home in the city. His high school-aged sister despises him.
One day, Tooru buys a Bible from a religious solicitor who happens to stop by. Unbeknownst to him, it contains an aphrodisiac spell.
Naturally, he tries it on his hated sister.
To his shock, she becomes completely obedient to his every command.
And so begins the humiliating prologue of turning his sister into a cum-drinking doll…

translation:
主人公日田透是一个住在市区家中的家里蹲，高中生妹妹非常厌恶他。

一天，透从上门推销的宗教人士那里买到一本《圣经》，却不知道里面藏着催情咒语。于是，他自然把咒语用在了自己讨厌的妹妹身上。

令他震惊的是，妹妹完全服从他的每一个命令。

将妹妹变成喝精液的玩偶，这场屈辱的序幕就此拉开……
